guide.title: Kaizen User Guide
guide.description: Learn how to configure and fully leverage Kaizen's tools.

dashboard.title: Main Dashboard
dashboard.desc: The dashboard gives you a complete overview of your server's health at a glance.
points: Download Stats: Track successful, failed, and queued chapter downloads.
Integration Health: Visually monitor connectivity with Kavita or Komga.
Real-time Server Logs: Inspect background server operations second by second.

library.title: Library Management
library.desc: Add and organize your favorite series for automated downloads.
points: Smart Search: Search catalog providers directly to import and configure manga.
Metadata & Cover Override: Edit synopsis, genres, and upload custom base64 or URL covers.
Local Chapters: Browse downloaded chapter files and safely remove duplicates.

planToRead.title: Requests (Plan to Read)
planToRead.desc: A streamlined, secure workflow for requesting future reading material.
points: Add Requests: Readers suggest series without requiring direct download privileges.
Admin Approval: Administrators approve or reject requests with a single click.
Automatic Sync: Approved series are instantly integrated into the main download queue.

reader.title: Reading Experience
reader.desc: Enjoy your favorite manga comfortably on any device.
points: Premium Reader UI: Choose between horizontal sliding or continuous vertical scroll modes.
Paperback Integration: Sync reading progress directly using our official Paperback extension.
Clean Reader: An interface fully stripped of admin panels, focusing solely on reading.

scheduler.title: Smart Scheduler
scheduler.desc: Optimize and schedule automated update checks.
points: Load Distribution: Smart auto-staggering spreads checks to avoid IP bans.
Publication Status Filters: Automatically deactivate checks on completed or hiatus series.
Bulk Scheduling: Apply check intervals to entire groups of manga at once.

sources.title: Scrapers & Sources
sources.desc: Expand your catalog by connecting custom scraper repositories.
points: Official Sources: Sync with scrapers verified and curated by the Kaizen team.
GitHub Sync: Add public or private repository integrations with access tokens.
Manual Lua Upload: Instantly upload custom `.lua` scraper scripts directly from the browser.

settings.title: General Settings
settings.desc: Manage appearance preferences, security details, and database backups.
points: Dynamic Themes: Switch between the default style and the custom Kaizen palette.
Multi-User & Authentication: Toggle session guards and configure user roles.
Atomic Database Backups: Export or import configurations atomically for peace of mind.
